metatags.og:description: Independent and small chain coffee shops around Indianapolis. No big chain coffee shops.  Green markers indicate KNOWN wifi hotspots, blue markers do not have wifi, or they do have it, and I just don't know it. HOWEVER, I don't know of a single coffee shop that doesn't have wifi anymore, so they probably all do.  If your shop isn't listed, post a comment, and I'll add it.
